NovelAI4AUsage.description: Shows the NovelAI subscription tier, Anlas balance, and V5 free allowance, with token setup and manual refresh controls.

NovelAI4AReference.description: Drop images or Vibe files onto the node to manage mutually exclusive Vibe or Precise Reference cards. Character reference is included in Precise Reference.

0.tooltip: Multi-reference resource list for the NAI Sampler.

NovelAI4ASampler.description: Accepts separate positive, negative, character JSON, width, and height inputs, and switches automatically between text-to-image, image-to-image, and inpainting. When an image is connected, the image input owns the resolution.

streaming.name: Streaming
streaming.tooltip: Enable the NovelAI SSE streaming API.

0.tooltip: Standard ComfyUI image batch returned by NovelAI.

1.tooltip: Original NovelAI PNG bytes for the NAI Original Image Saver.

NovelAI4AOriginalSaver.description: Saves the original PNG returned by NovelAI directly to ComfyUI output without re-encoding, preserving all original metadata.

filename.name: Filename
filename.tooltip: Supports %time and %date; the extension is always PNG.

path.name: Path
path.tooltip: Relative path under ComfyUI output. Supports %time and %date.

NovelAI4AImageInput.description: Packages image-to-image or inpainting resources and independently chooses the generation resolution from the source aspect ratio. A connected mask enables inpainting automatically.

scale_to_budget.name: Scale to Pixel Budget
scale_to_budget.tooltip: When enabled, scale proportionally to the selected tier. When disabled, use the closest valid NAI size to the source pixel count. Mutually exclusive with Upscale.

size_class.name: Pixel Budget
size_class.tooltip: Used only when Scale to Pixel Budget is enabled.

upscale.name: Upscale
upscale.tooltip: Upscale with the official Enhance rule: multiply each side, then round up to the next multiple of 64. Mutually exclusive with Scale to Pixel Budget.

upscale_scale.name: Upscale Amount
upscale_scale.tooltip: Currently 1.5 only, matching official Enhance 1.5. Sides above 2048 are scaled back together.

0.tooltip: Dedicated image resource for the NAI Sampler.

NAI Meta Apply.description: Select or drop an original NovelAI image and apply its current metadata to NAI nodes according to the toggles.

NAI Meta Loader.description: Inspect image metadata and send models, generation settings, prompts, and characters to NAI nodes.

NAI Prompt Scheduler (4A Prompt Manager).description: Expands NAI wildcards and outputs separate positive prompt, negative prompt, character JSON, and resolution values.
